cards.text: David, Israel's king, calls in all his leaders, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds. Then he speaks to the whole assembly of Israel, and he's got a BIG plan. But first he checks with them: only if it seems good to them, and only if it's of the LORD their God.

cards.question: Before his plan starts, David wants to send word far and wide. Who does he want to come join them?

answers.text: All their brothers plus the priests and Levites
The kings of the nearby nations

cards.text: Then David gets to the heart of his plan. It's something he wants the whole nation to do together.

cards.question: David's big plan: all of Israel together will bring back the ___ of God.
David gives a reason for bringing the ark back, and it has to do with Saul, the king before him. What reason does David give?

answers.text: They did not inquire of God under Saul
Saul had hidden it from the people
Saul had sworn to bring it back

cards.question: When David shares his plan, the whole assembly agrees to it.

cards.text: So David gathers all Israel, from the River Shihor in Egypt all the way to Lebo-hamath. And I thought the junk drawer I spent years stuck in was crowded!
They all go up to Baalah of Judah, also called Kiriath-jearim, to bring up the ark of God the LORD, who is enthroned between the cherubim.

cards.question: The ark of God is at the house of a man named Abinadab, and now they carry it out. What do they carry it on?

cards.text: A NEW cart, with Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, guiding it (2 Samuel 6:3). I bet that thing still has the price sticker on the wheel.

cards.question: As the cart rolls along with the ark, it's a quiet and solemn march for David and the Israelites.

cards.text: David and all the Israelites are celebrating before God with all their might, with songs, harps, lyres, tambourines, cymbals AND trumpets! That's me when a batch comes out perfect, hopping on my gold base till the whole bakery shakes.
Then the whole parade reaches the threshing floor of Chidon. And the oxen stumble.

cards.question: The oxen pulling the cart stumble at the threshing floor of Chidon. What does Uzzah do?

answers.text: He takes hold of the ark
He jumps down to calm the oxen
He shouts for everyone to stop

cards.text: Then the anger of the LORD burns against Uzzah, and He strikes him down because he had put his hand on the ark. Uzzah dies right there before God.

cards.question: When the LORD bursts forth against Uzzah, David becomes ___.

cards.text: David names that place Perez-uzzah, and it was still called that when this was written. And that same day, David fears God.

cards.question: That day at Perez-uzzah, David fears God. What does David ask?

answers.text: How can I ever bring the ark of God to me
Who will guide the cart from here on
Where should we go to bury Uzzah

cards.question: David goes ahead and takes the ark with him to the City of David.

cards.text: David takes the ark aside to the house of a man named Obed-edom the Gittite. It stays there with his family for three months.

cards.question: While the ark of God stays at his house, what happens to Obed-edom's household?

answers.text: The LORD blesses it and all he owns
His family grows afraid and leaves
Sickness spreads all through his house

cards.text: Hang onto your apron, friend, because we're only one batch into this story.
